title: Left navigation sidebar is not behaving well
body:
The code behind the sidebar is a bit hairy so I did not felt like confident completely changing it. If someone knows better how to solve the following issues, please do it.

- [x] sidebar jumps when scrolling. This seems to be fixable by putting - 40 in here: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/f009c95fcab04e2137934e9511783bfcf43f2663/docgen/assets/js/sidebar.js#L17
<details>
<summary>sample gif</summary>

![jump](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/123822/20927328/64b37562-bbc1-11e6-9e60-9364c657a7c3.gif)
</details>

- [x] When sidebar content is big. Sidebar shows scroll at wrong place. Scroll should be only on the part AFTER the title (here widgets). Only the widgets list should be scrollable.
Then the title should always be visible, the widgets list scrollable and it should work.
<details>
<summary>sample gif</summary>

![scroll-bug](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/123822/20927433/de72b066-bbc1-11e6-816f-6f5df7273174.gif)
</details>

- [x] when reaching footer, sidebar jumps again
<details>
<summary>sample gif</summary>

![jumpagain](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/123822/20927472/110dfbac-bbc2-11e6-8c42-108e7e12ab06.gif)
</details>

Let's also check on mobile that the behavior is perfect and has no flaws.
